hypotheses.mechanism: Past-only trend times realized-volatility interaction may predict incremental BTC log-price change in selected regimes
hypotheses.pre_origin_features: Strictly completed, independently timestamped returns and realized volatility; do not infer availability from candle close alone
hypotheses.falsification_rule: Reject if an approved prospective paired loss test does not beat persistence after dependence-aware inference and full-slot accounting; also reject if placebo is indistinguishable
hypotheses.negative_control: Identical candidate complexity using prespecified lagged or training-only shuffled features, evaluated on the same future target schedule
